constraints: OWNER: ≤15 min onboarding, ≤5 min/week in one batched message (default)
STAFF: ≤17 planned min/week, 20 including safety margin; one phone, audio usable only within ~30 cm (stated)

FILMING: hands, tools, objects and voice only. No master faces until consent is given (masters' consent is stated as unknown). Clients only with consent recorded on camera, and client faces or before/after shots only with that consent. No minors without a parent's written OK (default)

PRICES: none usable. The ledger is empty and exact prices are a stated unknown, so no price, number or price-band claim goes into content until a dated price list or 2GIS/Instagram price ≤7 days old is in the ledger (stated + default)

PRICE POSITION: the owner keeps current prices (stated). No discounts, no «дешевле/дороже, чем у…», no named or implied competitors. «Competitors ~30% cheaper» is an unverified owner perception and is used internally only, never in content (stated)
OFFER: none (default). Non-price offers only, each needing the owner's explicit «да»
CAPACITY: unknown per master and service (8 masters is stated but unverified). No «свободно сегодня/завтра», no fast-slot claims (default)
REGULATED: if the salon offers injections, peels or other medical-cosmetic procedures, show the process only, with no outcome claims («омолодит», «навсегда») and owner sign-off (default)
AVOID: politics, religion, ethnicity, mocking clients who chose a cheaper salon, naming or showing competitors, cheap-vs-expensive shaming (default)

ACCOUNTS: WhatsApp booking and 2GIS card exist (stated). Instagram and TikTok are unknown: the agent searches, and a missing account becomes an owner ask. Commercial-library music only on business accounts (default)
APPROVAL: owner approves each weekly batch. Offers, faces and any spend always need explicit approval (default)
GUARDRAIL: median first WhatsApp reply ≤15 min in working hours
GUARDRAIL: chat→booking rate not below the baseline
GUARDRAIL: 2GIS rating not below its current level (evidence: owner reports good reviews; agent to fetch)
GUARDRAIL: zero price cuts or unapproved discounts during the sprint
assumptions: SECONDARY: retention_or_loyalty. «Клиенты уходят» may mean regulars stop coming back. It gets ≤20% of slots this sprint (care_howto and reply content, WhatsApp Status for existing contacts, broadcast to opted-in contacts only). A full retention plan waits until the export shows who leaves.

LADDER: competitors are cheaper → clients leave → owner wants to keep bookings without cutting price → weekly booked visits (the first number counted every week). Fork: (a) new inquiries that stall after the price, (b) regulars who lapse, (c) clients who follow a master who left. Chose (a) plus free-capacity slots as primary because it is measurable through codes and labels and cheapest to move. (b) is SECONDARY; (c) is a non-marketing check.

BOTTLENECK: unknown, low confidence (~30%). Lead hypothesis: consideration/conversion, meaning chats stall after the price is sent («дорого», «подумаю», «а там дешевле») because the price arrives with no explanation of value and no next step. Alternative: conversion leak from slow first replies. Evidence: only the owner's statement. 2GIS reviews are stated as good, which suggests the service itself is not the cause. Verify: chat export (where chats die, median reply time, close rate) during week 0, by 2026-10-16.

[ASSUMPTION][strategist judgment beyond METHOD] In beauty salons a large share of churn usually follows individual masters (a master leaves or cuts their own price and clients go with them), and price is a convenient explanation. | if wrong: the plan stays content plus conversion | verify: question 1 to the owner plus the export, by 2026-10-10.

[ASSUMPTION] Disguised non-marketing check before any content push: reply time, which services lost clients, master turnover, seasonality, and 2GIS review trend. | if one of these is the cause: state it in push_back and fix it first | verify: agent fetches 2GIS and the owner sends the chat export during week 0.

[ASSUMPTION] Competitors being ~30% cheaper is the owner's perception, not a dated comparison. | if wrong: the price-objection insight weakens | verify: agent reads public 2GIS/Instagram price lists of nearby salons for internal context only, by 2026-10-14. Never published or used as «дешевле/дороже».

[ASSUMPTION] Service lines are hair, nails and brows/lashes, with no medical-cosmetic procedures. | if wrong: REGULATED rules apply and outcome claims are banned | verify: agent fetches the 2GIS card and price list by 2026-10-12.
[ASSUMPTION] Close rate is about 50% of new inquiries (placeholder). | if wrong: REALISM numbers rescale | verify: chat export by 2026-10-16.

REALISM (illustrative, every input is an [ASSUMPTION]): baseline about 40 WhatsApp bookings/week. Expected +10% gives +4/week × 4 weeks = 16 extra bookings. req_chats = 16 ÷ 0.5 = 32 coded chats. At 0.3–3 chats per 1k views, req_views = 11k–107k. ach_views = 20 posts × pooled median of about 500 (new or unknown account) × 1.8 ≈ 18k. Ratio is 0.6–5.9, so organic acquisition alone ranges from stretch to unrealistic. The conservative target (stop the decline) depends mostly on conversion fixes and the warm base, not on views. Levers: WhatsApp reply scripts that explain value after the price, Status and opted-in broadcast to existing clients, a longer window. Boost question deferred to week 2 (F10). Recompute once the export arrives.

[ASSUMPTION] Instagram exists but its performance is unknown, and there is no TikTok. | if wrong: week-1 channel plan changes | verify: agent search by 2026-10-12; a missing account becomes an owner ask.
[ASSUMPTION] Default posting window is lunch and 19:00–22:00 local. Not tested.

insights.insight: [price_value] When a client gets our price in WhatsApp and remembers a cheaper salon nearby, she wants the same result for less. She cannot see what the difference pays for (minutes per client, prep steps, finishing), so she says «подумаю» and tries the cheaper place. We can show the invisible steps with the master's hands at close range. This moves weekly undiscounted bookings because it answers the price doubt at the moment the chat stalls, without a price cut or a comparison. PROVISIONAL (strategist judgment beyond METHOD): every item is assumption-only, so C4 test 1 (evidenced) fails. The insight is kept to unblock step 4 and is capped at 2. Rerun step 3 when the chat export and 2GIS fetch arrive (by 2026-10-16).
insights.tension: Wants the same result for less vs cannot see what our price pays for
insights.who_feels_it: A client who has just received our price in WhatsApp and knows a cheaper salon a few streets away
insights.content_reality: The master's hands doing the prep and finishing steps a client normally doesn't notice, shot at «маникюрный стол» or «кресло мастера», phone ≤30 cm, faces 0. No ledger prices or process facts yet, so: show the process only. No «поэтому дороже», no numbers, no comparison. why_it_costs only after the owner confirms the steps (NEEDS FACT).

insights.insight: [friction] When someone texts «а сколько стоит?» and gets a bare price with no next step, she wants a quick yes or no on whether it's worth it. The chat gives her nothing to say yes to, so she drifts to whichever salon answers faster or cheaper. We can show a master answering the real recurring question in her own voice, and fix the reply script with one value line plus one question. This moves the chat→booking rate, the cheapest lever for 'stop the decline'. If the export shows slow first replies (>60 min median), that is the leak to fix before more content (A3 conversion). PROVISIONAL: no export yet, capped at 2.
insights.tension: Wants a fast, clear answer about value and a slot vs gets a bare price and no next step
insights.who_feels_it: New inquirers comparing 2–3 salons in WhatsApp in the same evening
insights.content_reality: Anonymised question card (screen mode) plus the master's voice recorded at ≤30 cm in «тихий угол», over hands-at-work footage at «маникюрный стол». No real chat questions counted yet, so recognition/question content only. Wording must come from ≥2 real matching messages after the export.

insights.insight: [tension] When she has an event coming (a той, a family celebration, a work party), a client who tries a cheaper salon risks something worse than lost money: arriving with chipped coating or a haircut she hides. Price shopping feels risky exactly when it matters, but she has no way to judge quality before sitting down. We can show what a master checks and agrees with the client before starting, and how the work is finished, so the anxiety is resolved by seeing the process. This holds bookings at current price without attacking anyone. Never show or mock 'bad work from elsewhere'.
insights.tension: Wants to save money vs fears a bad result before an important event, in front of people
insights.who_feels_it: Someone with an event within 2–14 days, deciding between her usual salon and a cheaper one
insights.content_reality: The pre-service check and finishing details on hands only at «маникюрный стол» / «кресло мастера». E23 is unconfirmed, so the check ritual needs owner confirmation (NEEDS FACT) before it is framed as «у нас так». Until then: empathy/recognition content and practical checklists only, no outcome claims.

insights.insight: [proof] When a hesitant client is choosing, she trusts strangers' reviews more than the salon's words, but she won't dig through 2GIS. So she defaults to price, the only thing she can compare at a glance. We can show real public 2GIS reviews (no names, «из отзыва в 2ГИС») over the master's hands doing the praised work. This moves bookings because it moves the comparison from price to evidence. Strength stays at 2 until the agent fetches the card: rating, count and recurring praise words are unknown, and «хорошие отзывы» is only the owner's word.
insights.tension: Wants certainty from other clients vs only price is easy to compare
insights.who_feels_it: A prospective client who found the salon on 2GIS or was sent our video, and is comparing options
insights.content_reality: Zero staff minutes possible: screen recording of the public 2GIS card, plus library hands footage once it exists. Location «маникюрный стол» for new detail shots. No reviews fetched yet: nothing may be quoted, and no rating number may appear until it is a ledger fact.

insights.insight: [moment] Before a той, a family celebration or the start of the pre–New Year party season, a client wants to look right in photos and in front of relatives. A few days out, certainty matters more than a lower price, but she leaves booking late and grabs any free slot. We can show a practical 'what to book and when before an event' guide with hands-on demonstration, steered to slots with free capacity (weekday daytime by default). This moves bookings onto free capacity at full price. No «свободно завтра» or deadline claims without owner-confirmed slots.
insights.tension: Wants to look right at the event vs leaves it late and books on price or availability
insights.who_feels_it: People in Шымкент with a той or celebration 2–14 days away
insights.content_reality: Hands-on demo of an event-ready service at «кресло мастера» / «маникюрный стол», plus a calendar-cue on-screen frame. Event-season dates and free slots are unverified, so practical/recognition framing only. Steer to weekdays only after question 3 is answered.

insights.insight: [hidden_knowledge] When a client compares salons, she has no criteria beyond price and photos of finished nails or hair, because she doesn't know what a well-done job looks like up close: clean cuticle line, coating sealed at the edge, even ends. She judges on the one number she understands. We can give her the master's checklist of how to tell good work, shown on real hands. This is useful wherever she goes, and it quietly sets criteria where a careful salon wins. It moves bookings through saves and trust rather than through a claim. Never say who fails the checklist.
insights.tension: Wants to choose well vs has no way to judge quality except price
insights.who_feels_it: Clients who switch salons and can't tell whether the difference is real
insights.content_reality: Macro detail shots at ≤30 cm of finished work on hands at «маникюрный стол». Which checks the masters actually use is unconfirmed (NEEDS FACT: staff voice note «что мастер проверяет в готовой работе»). Until then, framed as «мастер считает» and limited to what is visibly filmed.

insights.insight: [content_reality] Snipping scissors, a file on a nail edge, the brush pulling gel: nobody outside the chair hears or sees these at close range, and the category posts the finished look with trending music on top (hypothesised convention E25). The outsider curiosity gap is the sound and the micro-process itself. We can capture close sound on the weak phone, which is its one strength at ≤30 cm. The possible hygiene ritual (sealed instrument pouch opened in front of the client) is held back until the owner confirms it and the camera shows it. This feeds reach (sensory/close_sound wildcards) and only indirectly the booking objective.
insights.tension: Outsider's curiosity gap: «снаружи этого никто не слышит и не видит так близко»
insights.who_feels_it: Any scroller in Шымкент, and existing clients who enjoy the ritual
insights.content_reality: Close-sound loops at «маникюрный стол» and «кресло мастера», phone on a stand 20–30 cm away, hands only, faces 0. Sounds are unverified until the staff reality scan. The sterilisation pouch shot is blocked by NEEDS FACT (E22).

insights.insight: [identity] Many clients don't choose a salon, they choose 'my master'. Loyalty is to a person's hands and judgment, and a stranger's lower price rarely beats that, but a new client has no way to meet the masters before booking. So she books on price. We can show each master as a recurring hands-and-voice character (how she works, what she won't do), so a new client picks a person instead of a price. This moves coded bookings to named masters with free slots. If the export shows clients left WITH a departed master (E26), that is a non-marketing problem (staffing and retention), and content will not fix it. That goes to push_back, not into ideas.
insights.tension: Wants a master she can trust vs can't meet anyone before booking, so price decides
insights.who_feels_it: New clients choosing a master for a recurring service, and regulars whose master has a free window
insights.content_reality: Voice-only or hands-only character episodes at each master's station, «кресло мастера» / «маникюрный стол». Speech only at ≤30 cm. Faces blocked until each master consents. Masters' willingness and free slots are unknown, so this waits for question 2 and question 3.

insights.insight: [price_value] WILDCARD. When a client is torn between us and a cheaper salon, every salon telling her «у нас качество» sounds like an ad, so she discounts it and goes with price. A salon that honestly says when a cheaper option is fine for her (e.g. a quick tidy-up between full visits) and when it isn't would be believed. We could film a master's honest take, framed as «мастер считает», at the station. This could build trust that holds full-price bookings for the services that matter, but it risks the owner's comfort and may push some low-margin demand away. Needs the owner's «да». Thin evidence, high distinctiveness.
insights.tension: Wants honest advice vs every salon claims quality, so the claims cancel out and price wins
insights.who_feels_it: Price-sensitive clients who suspect salons upsell
insights.content_reality: The master's voice at ≤30 cm in «тихий угол» over hands-at-work footage at «маникюрный стол». It is pure opinion with no ledger facts, so it must be framed as an opinion and must not name or imply competitors. Owner approval of the anti_sell stance is required.

insights.insight: [friction] SECONDARY (retention, ≤20% of slots). Regular clients mean to come back, but without a reminder or a reason the gap stretches, and a cheaper salon's ad lands during that gap. So they try it 'just once'. We can post care how-tos (how to make a result last until the next visit) and the week's best videos on WhatsApp Status, broadcasting only to opted-in contacts. This moves repeat bookings from the warm base, the fastest lever within the 4-week window. Unobserved until the export separates new from returning clients.
insights.tension: Wants to keep her regular look vs no prompt to rebook, so the gap opens for cheaper alternatives
insights.who_feels_it: Existing clients 3–6 weeks after their last visit
insights.content_reality: Care micro-demos on hands at «маникюрный стол» / «кресло мастера». Care advice is framed as «мастер советует», with no outcome or duration claims (no ledger facts). Status and broadcast depend on opt-in.

insights.insight: [price_value] When a client gets our price in WhatsApp and remembers a cheaper salon nearby, she wants the same result for less. She cannot see what the difference pays for (minutes per client, prep steps, finishing), so she says «подумаю» and tries the cheaper place. We can show the invisible steps with the master's hands at close range. This moves weekly undiscounted bookings because it answers the price doubt at the moment the chat stalls, without a price cut or a comparison. PROVISIONAL (strategist judgment beyond METHOD): every item is assumption-only, so C4 test 1 (evidenced) fails. The insight is kept to unblock step 4 and is capped at 2. Rerun step 3 when the chat export and 2GIS fetch arrive (by 2026-10-16).

insights.insight: [friction] When someone texts «а сколько стоит?» and gets a bare price with no next step, she wants a quick yes or no on whether it's worth it. The chat gives her nothing to say yes to, so she drifts to whichever salon answers faster or cheaper. We can show a master answering the real recurring question in her own voice, and fix the reply script with one value line plus one question. This moves the chat→booking rate, the cheapest lever for 'stop the decline'. If the export shows slow first replies (>60 min median), that is the leak to fix before more content (A3 conversion). PROVISIONAL: no export yet, capped at 2.

No real chat questions counted yet, so recognition/question content only. Wording must come from ≥2 real matching messages after the export.

insights.insight: [tension] When she has an event coming (a той, a family celebration, a work party), a client who tries a cheaper salon risks something worse than lost money: arriving with chipped coating or a haircut she hides. Price shopping feels risky exactly when it matters, but she has no way to judge quality before sitting down. We can show what a master checks and agrees with the client before starting, and how the work is finished, so the anxiety is resolved by seeing the process. This holds bookings at current price without attacking anyone. Never show or mock 'bad work from elsewhere'.
insights.tension: Wants to save money vs fears a bad result before an important event, in front of people
insights.who_feels_it: Someone with an event within 2–14 days, deciding between her usual salon and a cheaper one
insights.content_reality: The pre-service check and finishing details on hands only at «маникюрный стол» / «кресло мастера». Until then: empathy/recognition content and practical checklists only, no outcome claims.

insights.insight: [proof] When a hesitant client is choosing, she trusts strangers' reviews more than the salon's words, but she won't dig through 2GIS. So she defaults to price, the only thing she can compare at a glance. We can show real public 2GIS reviews (no names, «из отзыва в 2ГИС») over the master's hands doing the praised work. This moves bookings because it moves the comparison from price to evidence. Strength stays at 2 until the agent fetches the card: rating, count and recurring praise words are unknown, and «хорошие отзывы» is only the owner's word.

insights.insight: [moment] Before a той, a family celebration or the start of the pre–New Year party season, a client wants to look right in photos and in front of relatives. A few days out, certainty matters more than a lower price, but she leaves booking late and grabs any free slot. We can show a practical 'what to book and when before an event' guide with hands-on demonstration, steered to slots with free capacity (weekday daytime by default). This moves bookings onto free capacity at full price. No «свободно завтра» or deadline claims without owner-confirmed slots.

insights.content_reality: Hands-on demo of an event-ready service at «кресло мастера» / «маникюрный стол», plus a calendar-cue on-screen frame. Event-season dates and free slots are unverified, so practical/recognition framing only. Steer to weekdays only after question 3 is answered.

insights.insight: [hidden_knowledge] When a client compares salons, she has no criteria beyond price and photos of finished nails or hair, because she doesn't know what a well-done job looks like up close: clean cuticle line, coating sealed at the edge, even ends. She judges on the one number she understands. We can give her the master's checklist of how to tell good work, shown on real hands. This is useful wherever she goes, and it quietly sets criteria where a careful salon wins. It moves bookings through saves and trust rather than through a claim. Never say who fails the checklist.
insights.tension: Wants to choose well vs has no way to judge quality except price
insights.who_feels_it: Clients who switch salons and can't tell whether the difference is real

Which checks the masters actually use is unconfirmed (NEEDS FACT: staff voice note «что мастер проверяет в готовой работе»). Until then, framed as «мастер считает» and limited to what is visibly filmed.

insights.insight: [content_reality] Snipping scissors, a file on a nail edge, the brush pulling gel: nobody outside the chair hears or sees these at close range, and the category posts the finished look with trending music on top (hypothesised convention E25). The outsider curiosity gap is the sound and the micro-process itself. We can capture close sound on the weak phone, which is its one strength at ≤30 cm. The possible hygiene ritual (sealed instrument pouch opened in front of the client) is held back until the owner confirms it and the camera shows it. This feeds reach (sensory/close_sound wildcards) and only indirectly the booking objective.
insights.tension: Outsider's curiosity gap: «снаружи этого никто не слышит и не видит так близко»
insights.who_feels_it: Any scroller in Шымкент, and existing clients who enjoy the ritual

insights.insight: [identity] Many clients don't choose a salon, they choose 'my master'. Loyalty is to a person's hands and judgment, and a stranger's lower price rarely beats that, but a new client has no way to meet the masters before booking. So she books on price. We can show each master as a recurring hands-and-voice character (how she works, what she won't do), so a new client picks a person instead of a price. This moves coded bookings to named masters with free slots. If the export shows clients left WITH a departed master (E26), that is a non-marketing problem (staffing and retention), and content will not fix it. That goes to push_back, not into ideas.
insights.tension: Wants a master she can trust vs can't meet anyone before booking, so price decides
insights.who_feels_it: New clients choosing a master for a recurring service, and regulars whose master has a free window
insights.content_reality: Voice-only or hands-only character episodes at each master's station, «кресло мастера» / «маникюрный стол». Speech only at ≤30 cm. Faces blocked until each master consents. Masters' willingness and free slots are unknown, so this waits for question 2 and question 3.

insights.insight: [price_value] WILDCARD. When a client is torn between us and a cheaper salon, every salon telling her «у нас качество» sounds like an ad, so she discounts it and goes with price. A salon that honestly says when a cheaper option is fine for her (e.g. a quick tidy-up between full visits) and when it isn't would be believed. We could film a master's honest take, framed as «мастер считает», at the station. This could build trust that holds full-price bookings for the services that matter, but it risks the owner's comfort and may push some low-margin demand away. Needs the owner's «да». Thin evidence, high distinctiveness.
insights.tension: Wants honest advice vs every salon claims quality, so the claims cancel out and price wins
insights.who_feels_it: Price-sensitive clients who suspect salons upsell
insights.content_reality: The master's voice at ≤30 cm in «тихий угол» over hands-at-work footage at «маникюрный стол». It is pure opinion with no ledger facts, so it must be framed as an opinion and must not name or imply competitors. Owner approval of the anti_sell stance is required.

insights.insight: [friction] SECONDARY (retention, ≤20% of slots). Regular clients mean to come back, but without a reminder or a reason the gap stretches, and a cheaper salon's ad lands during that gap. So they try it 'just once'. We can post care how-tos (how to make a result last until the next visit) and the week's best videos on WhatsApp Status, broadcasting only to opted-in contacts. This moves repeat bookings from the warm base, the fastest lever within the 4-week window. Unobserved until the export separates new from returning clients.
insights.tension: Wants to keep her regular look vs no prompt to rebook, so the gap opens for cheaper alternatives
insights.who_feels_it: Existing clients 3–6 weeks after their last visit
insights.content_reality: Care micro-demos on hands at «маникюрный стол» / «кресло мастера». Care advice is framed as «мастер советует», with no outcome or duration claims (no ledger facts). Status and broadcast depend on opt-in.

on_screen_ru: Сколько длится один дизайн? Часы в кадре

output.name: Meet the master before you book (price_pressure, Шымкент beauty salon, HYPOTHETICAL client, sprint 2026-10-19 → 2026-11-15)
output.big_idea: In a salon you don't buy a price, you trust one person's hands for an hour. A client can't meet that person before she books, so she compares the one number she can see. Every week we let people meet each master's hands, voice and judgment up close, filmed at 20 cm. That way the choice moves from the number to the person, at the current price and towards masters with free slots. This generates at least 20 episodes (8 masters × their rules, checks, sounds and event prep). It is provable on camera because it shows only real hands and real process. It points at one action: a coded WhatsApp chat asking for time with a specific master.
output.why_this_wins: This plan does not forecast results. It is built so that audience data can pick the winners, as required by L1 and learnings L001 and L003. The message carries no price, number or comparison, so it needs no ledger fact (facts_usable is empty). It is true by construction, because every video shows a real master's hands or voice. It also avoids the hypothesised category convention of finished nails under music (E25), which peers are assumed to use. The plan rests on these insights: I01 (price_value), I08 (identity), I06 (hidden_knowledge), I05 (moment), I07 (content reality), I09 (wildcard) and I10 (secondary retention). I01 says the client can't see what the price pays for (E04, E05, E06, E13, E16). I08 says loyalty goes to the person, not the salon (E26, E02, E10, E20). I06 says she has no criteria except price (E23, E17, E25, E30). I05 says certainty matters more than price before a той (E19, E20). I07 is the close-sound reach layer (E21, E22, E09). I09 is the honest-signal wildcard. I10 covers the warm base. Price pressure is handled without cuts, comparisons or naming anyone, as the PRICE POSITION constraint requires. The hero series «Руки мастера» (ID17) points each CTA at a named master with free slots, which uses free capacity and gives the content a conversion step. Caveat: every insight is assumption-only (strength ≤2). The plan is therefore a set of diagnostic shots on goal across 5 drivers and 5 formats in week 1. It will be re-grounded when step 3 is rerun on the chat export and the 2GIS fetch by 2026-10-16. Learning plan: per-video codes plus «Видео»/«Записан» labels tell us which arms produce full-price bookings rather than views. The WhatsApp layer (a next step after the price, a 15-minute reply) is tested in parallel, because the lead bottleneck hypothesis is a stall after the price, not reach.

series.name: «Руки мастера»
series.role: HERO. Conversion and trust. Metric: coded chats per 1k that name this master, and their booking rate. Opening ritual (fixed): frame 1 is this master's hands already working at her own station, her own voice starts by 0.5 s (recorded at 25–30 cm in «тихий угол»), and a series tag «Руки мастера» sits top-centre. Fixed structure: one rule she holds → why, in her words → close-up of her signature detail → CTA to her free slots. Variable: the master (one per episode) and her rule. Voice and hands only, no faces. If a master declines voice, she appears with hands plus captioned text «мастер считает».
series.cadence: 1 in week 1, then 2/week from week 2 once ≥2 masters have consented (each episode ≈4 staff min).

series.name: «Глазами мастера»
series.role: SUPPORTING: proof and utility. Metric: saves and shares per 1k, plus chat→booking rate for coded chats. Opening ritual: extreme macro (≤20 cm) of a tool or product meeting the nail, with audible sound and the series tag top-centre. Content: what the master looks at, believes or advises, always framed «мастер считает/советует». ID19 is the wildcard episode (anti_sell), and ID24 is the care episode that also serves the SECONDARY retention goal (≤20% of slots) via WhatsApp Status.
series.cadence: 1–2/week. Never two «file-on-nail» first frames in the same week.

series.name: «Перед тоем»
series.role: SUPPORTING: moment and conversion. Metric: coded chats per 1k that include an event date, and bookings on free weekday slots. Opening: a recognisable pre-event situation on hands. The CTA asks for the event date and never promises a slot.

offer.proposal: Без акций и без скидок: цену не трогаем, это решение владельца. Кандидат на 3-ю неделю (только после «да» владельца и только если на 2-й неделе чаты останавливаются после цены): «Пришлите в WhatsApp фото ваших ногтей и код {CODE} — мастер посмотрит и до записи подскажет, что подойдёт». Это бесплатно и не обязывает записываться. Срок — до 15.11, без ограничений по количеству. Тест: тот же формат роликов с этим предложением и без него.

channels.role: This is where bookings close and the most likely leak, so it is fixed in week 0 before content scales. Per-video codes come from code. Admin labels are «Видео» and «Записан». Target first reply ≤15 min in working hours; if the export shows a median over 60 min, that is flagged as leak #1 ahead of any content. Quick replies are drafted by the agent and approved once by the owner. (1) Coded chat: «Здравствуйте! Вы по видео {CODE}. Подскажите, какая услуга и какой день вам удобен — сразу скажем, у какого мастера есть окно.» (2) After sending a price (price only from the dated price list in the ledger): «[цена из прайса]. Хотите, подберём мастера и время? Какой день вам удобнее?» This sends the price with a next step, never a bare number. (3) Codeless chat: «Подскажите, пожалуйста, откуда вы о нас узнали?» (4) Handover: «Спасибо, что пришли! Если понравилось — пара слов в 2ГИС очень поможет мастеру.» No incentive is offered for the review. We never argue about price and never mention other salons.

Warm base, the fastest lever in a 4-week window: the week's best 2 videos plus the care episode (ID24) go to existing contacts. Broadcasts go only to contacts who opted in. Real free-slot announcements appear only when the admin confirms them the same day.

Account status is unknown: the agent searches, and a missing account is an owner ask. Reels is the shop window where Шымкент clients check that the salon is legitimate. Pin 3 posts: the best «Руки мастера» episode, the best «Глазами мастера» episode, and «Как записаться». Bio: services, address (from 2GIS once fetched), and a wa.me link with a bio code. Highlights: «Мастера», «Как записаться», «Отзывы» (screenshots of public 2GIS reviews, no names). No «Цены» highlight until a dated price list is in the ledger.
Non-follower reach and the fastest test bed. It is a new account (assumption), so we treat it as a cold start and don't judge arms on its first 5–10 posts. Creating it needs the owner's OK.
Cheap cross-post with a search tail. Titles in plain service words (e.g. «Снятие гель-лака у мастера»).

Proof and local intent. The agent fetches rating, review count and recurring praise words (guardrail baseline, future I04 content). Photo refresh with real hands-on work. The handover quick reply asks for a review. Never fake or incentivised reviews.

Only for DR2 posts with at least 1 coded chat or a conversion role, using click-to-WhatsApp within a Шымкент radius. Ceiling CPQC_cap = average check × gross margin × close rate × 0.3. All three inputs are unknown, so the cap is computed in week 2 from the owner's numbers and the export. Stop-loss: stop if spend reaches 5× the cap with fewer than 3 coded chats, or if cost per coded chat rises 3 days in a row. Never with an unconfirmed offer.

measurement.success_metric: WhatsApp bookings at current, undiscounted prices per week, 2026-10-19 → 2026-11-15. Conservative: at baseline (the decline is stopped). Expected: +10% vs baseline. Stretch: +20% vs baseline. The baseline comes from the 4 weeks before 10-19 in the chat export, or from the week-0 count if there is no export, and the multiple is fixed at the end of week 2. Guardrails: chat→booking rate (chats labelled «Записан» ÷ new inbound chats) not below baseline; median first reply ≤15 min; 2GIS rating not below its current level; zero price cuts.
measurement.attribution: Each video gets its own WhatsApp code, spoken where there is a talk shot, on screen for ≥2 s, in the caption and in the pinned comment, plus a prefilled wa.me link in the bio and wherever links are clickable. Coded bookings are reported as a floor, and total weekly bookings vs the 4-week baseline as an estimate. Admin labels «Видео»/«Записан» are counted from the weekly export. Codeless chats get «Откуда о нас узнали?». Walk-ins: the admin asks «откуда узнали?» and notes the answer «видео» (assumption: the admin keeps a tally). Attribution window: 30 days per code. No Kaspi channel.
leading_indicators: views_48h ÷ median of the last 15 posts on that platform (pooled beauty_salon median, assumed ~500, until 10 own posts), using the log ratio for arms
3-second hold / skip rate and average % watched
shares + saves per 1,000 views vs median, with driver matched to its own metric (sensory → replays, practical_value → saves, identity → shares)
coded WhatsApp chats per 1,000 views, and the share of them naming a specific master or an event date
measurement.review_cadence: Each post is read at 48 h (allocation) and 7 days (final). Weekly campaign read on Monday, with an owner report of ≤5 lines in Russian, true numbers only and at most 1 decision. Phase review in week 4 (2026-11-13). Code attribution window 30 days. Allocation metric is relative views plus shares and saves until the client reaches 20 coded chats in total, then coded chats per 1,000 views.

decision_rules: DR0 (client-specific, week 0): if the export shows a median first reply over 60 min in working hours, or that most lost clients left with a departed master, fixing replies or staffing comes first. Conversion-CTA content is held and only reach/trust posts go out until it is fixed. The owner is told in one sentence.
DR1 Read every post at 48 h and at 7 days, per platform, against that platform's own baseline.

DR2 Breakout: ≥3× platform median at 48 h (≈1,500 views on the pooled ~500 median [ASSUMPTION]; switch to the own median after 10 posts), or shares + saves per 1k ≥2× median. Then, within 7 days: a part 2 or the same insight in a new format, plus a reply to the top comment. Pin it if conversion-relevant, put it on WhatsApp Status, and make it boost-eligible. At ≥10× median (≈5,000 views) it becomes a series, and the owner hears «вирусный» described as a tail event, not a plan.
DR3 Hook failure (3-second hold <0.7× account median): re-cut with a different first frame and hook text, and repost ≥7 days later, once only.
DR4 Body failure (hold OK, completion <0.7× median): shorten and move the payoff earlier in the next episode. No repost as is.

DR5 Conversion-layer miss: views on plan but coded chats under 30% of plan by the end of week 3. Illustrative plan ≈8 coded chats/week [ASSUMPTION], recomputed after the export. Before more content, check the code on screen, in the caption and pinned comment, the bio wa.me link, and reply time.

DR6 Sales-handling miss: coded chats on plan but chat→booking below baseline. Report where chats die (after price / after «подумаю» / no reply) and draft reply scripts. Price stays the owner's call, and we never propose a discount.
DR7 Attention-only arm (≥10 posts, ≥10,000 views, 0 coded chats while other arms convert, e.g. «Звук кресла»): cap at 1 post/week and use its footage as B-roll.
DR8 Retire an arm when P(arm beats client median) <0.10 after ≥8 posts: drop it to the exploration floor; its data stays in the pool.

DR9 Boost only DR2 posts with ≥1 coded chat or a conversion role, within the owner's cap. Cap = average check × gross margin × close rate × 0.3, computed in week 2. Stop-loss: stop if spend reaches 5× the cap with fewer than 3 coded chats, or if cost per coded chat rises 3 days in a row. Never with an unconfirmed offer.

DR10 Capacity: when coded demand for a master or service reaches ≥80% of the free slots the owner reported, pause CTAs pointing to her and redirect to masters or times with free slots. Until slots are known, CTAs only offer to «подсказать свободное время» and never promise one.

DR11 Honesty kill-switch: if a comment credibly disputes something shown or said (e.g. a care tip, the removal opinion), pause that series, verify with the master, and tell the owner the same day. Price-comparison comments («у них дешевле») get a calm reply draft and are never argued with or answered by naming anyone.

DR12 Pivot: if by week 4 no arm has P(beats median) >0.6 and weekly bookings are still below baseline, rerun step 3 with fresh chats and voice notes, diagnose the funnel, and send the owner an honest report with options: another bottleneck, warm-base push, non-price offer, boost, or pause.
DR13 Claims: a «winner» needs P(best) ≥0.9, n ≥10 per contender and an interval. Otherwise it is reported as «лидирует, рано судить».
DR14 Staff: if card completion is below 80% for 2 weeks, move to fewer locations (only «маникюрный стол»), face-free shots, shorter takes, and more zero-minute reply and re-cut videos.
DR15 Owner: if more than 30% of the batch is rejected, read the reasons and update the constraints. A fact rejection means fixing the ledger first.
DR16 Never delete flops, except for truth, consent or legal problems.
learning_questions: Where do chats die: after the price, after «подумаю», or on slow replies? Does sending the price with one next-step question raise the chat→booking rate at unchanged prices?
Does «Руки мастера» (voice + hands of a named master) produce coded chats that name that master and turn into bookings on her free slots, or only follows?
Do «Глазами мастера» knowledge videos (check_before_buy, myth_check, care_howto) produce coded full-price bookings, or only saves and shares?
Does the той framing («Перед тоем») bring chats with an event date on weekday or free slots?
Does the honest anti-sell wildcard (ID19) raise shares and saves without lowering the chat→booking rate?

owner_asks.ask: Может ли администратор в WhatsApp посмотреть фото ногтей клиентки и подсказать, что подойдёт, до записи? 1 — да, 2 — нет. По умолчанию: 2, такое в роликах не обещаем.
owner_asks.why: Needed for the ID09 CTA and the candidate non-price offer. We never promise what staff won't do.

owner_asks.ask: Есть ли у салона Instagram и TikTok? Пришлите названия аккаунтов или «нет». Можно ли завести TikTok? 1 — да, 2 — нет. По умолчанию: публикуем только туда, где аккаунт уже есть.
owner_asks.why: Determines the channel plan and the baselines. Creating a new account needs the owner's decision.

owner_asks.ask: Мы пришлём 4 готовых ответа для WhatsApp (на код из видео, после цены, «откуда узнали?», просьба об отзыве в 2ГИС). Ответьте «да» или поправьте. По умолчанию: не используем, пока не одобрите.
owner_asks.why: The conversion layer is the cheapest lever for 'stop the decline', and outward messages need the owner's approval (L8).

risks: HYPOTHETICAL client: the ledger is empty and every insight is assumption-only (strength ≤2). The whole plan is diagnostic and must be re-grounded by rerunning step 3 on the export and 2GIS by 2026-10-16. No number, price or rating may appear in any audience string until it is a ledger fact.

Strategist judgment beyond METHOD: price_pressure has no row in the F3 mix table. Target mix used: ~35% reach, ~35% proof/utility, ~30% conversion, with secondary retention ≤20% of slots. Week 1 runs 40% reach, 20% trust, 40% conversion.

Strategist judgment beyond METHOD: the series list has a hero plus 3 supporting series. ID24 (secondary retention) is folded into «Глазами мастера» instead of getting its own container. The hero «Глазами мастера» ritual fixes the first-frame type and a series tag rather than one fixed spoken line, because the slate hooks differ.
NEEDS FACT: masters' consent to have their voice and name published (owner) — blocks ID17 and ID19 in their voice form.
NEEDS FACT: owner's explicit «да» on the anti-sell stance (owner) — blocks shooting ID19.
NEEDS FACT: the master's own checks on finished work (staff voice note) — ID09.
NEEDS FACT: master confirms the pre-той advice points (staff voice note) — ID20.
NEEDS FACT: master confirms the care tips (staff voice note) — ID24.
NEEDS FACT: the belief «снятие гель-лака портит ноготь» appears in ≥2 real chats or public reviews (agent: export/2GIS), plus the master's own opinion (voice note) — blocks publishing ID13.
NEEDS FACT: the admin will review clients' nail photos in WhatsApp (owner) — blocks the ID09 CTA and the candidate offer.
NEEDS FACT: which masters and services have free slots per week (owner) — blocks master-specific CTAs and the DR10 thresholds.
NEEDS FACT: той-season peak dates relevant in Шымкент (agent; native check) — timing for ID15 and ID20.
NEEDS FACT: a dated price list ≤7 days old (owner/agent re-fetch) — needed for the after-price quick reply, never for comparisons.
NEEDS FACT: 2GIS rating, review count and recurring praise words (agent fetch) — guardrail baseline and future I04 content.
NEEDS FACT: average check, gross margin and close rate (owner + export) — the boost cap cannot be computed until week 2.
Non-marketing risk: if clients are leaving with a departed or underpricing master, or replies are slow, content will not fix it (DR0). Say so plainly rather than producing more videos.

Coverage risk: 7 of 8 slate ideas are nails, but the salon has 8 masters, possibly with hair and brows. Bookings may pile up on nail masters while free slots sit with others. Mitigation: point the CTA only at confirmed free slots; ID17 can be filmed with a hair master at «кресло мастера».

First-frame repetition: 5 of 8 slate ideas open on a macro nail at «маникюрный стол». ID13 is deferred to week 2 because it repeats ID01's file-on-nail frame. Week-1 publish order alternates frame types.

Consent: client hands appear only after her verbal OK (no face or voice), otherwise staff hands are used. ID13 is filmed on a staff member's own nail with her consent. ID15 must keep its «постановка» label visible.
Capacity unknown: no CTA promises «свободно сегодня/завтра» or «успеем». CTAs only offer to suggest free time.
Price-pressure comments («у них дешевле») are likely. We reply calmly via drafts, never argue, never name or imply anyone, and never make «дешевле/дороже» claims.
Cold-start accounts: Instagram/TikTok status is unknown, so early arm reads are noisy. Do not judge arms on the first 5–10 TikTok posts.
Realism: organic acquisition alone ranges from stretch to unrealistic (REALISM ratio 0.6–5.9, all inputs assumed). The conservative target depends mainly on the WhatsApp layer and the warm base.
Kazakh captions only after a native speaker's check.

output.persona: Владелица салона красоты в Шымкенте (8 мастеров). Цены снижать не хочу, клиенты уходят к тем, кто дешевле. Своё время и рабочее время мастеров считаю в деньгах.
output.best_idea: Неделя 0: сначала разобрать переписку в WhatsApp (где обрывается запись, как быстро отвечаем) и только потом снимать ролики. Плюс готовый ответ, где после цены сразу идёт следующий шаг: «Хотите, подберём мастера и время? Какой день удобнее?». Это бесплатно, почти не отнимает времени у мастеров и бьёт ровно в мою боль: человек узнал цену и пропал. Если ответы окажутся медленными, это правило вообще избавит меня от лишних роликов.

refutations.target: Распределение усилий: «тёплая база — самый быстрый рычаг», но на удержание выделено ≤20% слотов
refutations.why_fails: План сам признаёт, что одних роликов за 4 недели не хватит (REALISM 0.6–5.9), а самое быстрое — вернуть тех, кто уже ходил. При этом на них отведено не больше 20%, и это один ролик про уход за ногтями в статусах. Нет ни одного адресного сообщения тем, кто перестал приходить. Главные силы уходят в охват, хотя сам план считает его малореальным.
refutations.fix: Добавить в неделю 1 отдельную задачу: администратор находит в экспорте клиенток, которые не были 6–10 недель, и пишет им личное сообщение без скидки (от их мастера, с предложением свободного времени). Текст одобряю один раз. Долю удержания поднять до 40% на первые 2 недели.

refutations.target: Серия «Руки мастера» (ID17): голос и имя мастера, CTA «к этому мастеру»
refutations.why_fails: В плане сказано, что клиенты часто уходят вслед за мастером. Если я на свои деньги и время раскручу голос и имя конкретного мастера, а она уйдёт или начнёт брать клиентов на дому, вся эта аудитория уйдёт с ней. Мой риск в плане не учтён.
refutations.fix: Сначала задать мне вопрос 1 (уходят ли за мастером). Если да, в роликах говорит «мастер салона» и стоит бренд салона, без имени. Запись идёт через номер салона, а не через личный номер мастера. Имя только с моего отдельного «да» для каждого мастера.

refutations.target: Язык контента: только русский, казахский «опционально после проверки»
refutations.why_fails: В Шымкенте большая часть моих клиенток говорит по-казахски, особенно та аудитория, у которой той. Ролики «Перед тоем» только на русском выглядят чужими и теряют ровно тех, кого мы зовём.
refutations.fix: Субтитры KZ+RU по умолчанию хотя бы для серии «Перед тоем» и для хуков. Носителя языка для проверки найти среди моих мастеров или администраторов (5 минут в неделю), а не держать это в плане как необязательное.

refutations.target: Почти весь слейт про маникюр (7 из 8 идей)
refutations.why_fails: У меня 8 мастеров, и если пустые окна у парикмахеров или бровистов, ролики нагонят запись туда, где и так занято. Сам план признаёт этот риск, но откладывает его на «следующий пакет». Тогда это не решает мою задачу заполнить свободные окна.
refutations.fix: До недели 1 по моему ответу на вопрос 3 переставить слейт: минимум 2 из 5 роликов первой недели должны быть про услугу, где реально есть окна.

refutations.target: ID19 «Честно: иногда салон вам не нужен»
refutations.why_fails: Клиенты и так уходят, а я ещё сама объясняю, что можно обойтись без салона. Рядом с дешёвыми конкурентами это читается как «экономьте». Подписывать такое мне неудобно.
refutations.fix: По умолчанию стоит «нет», и пусть так и остаётся. Если хотите что-то честное, сделайте формат «что дома делать НЕ надо и почему» без заголовка против салона.

refutations.target: ID01 «Звук кресла» (ASMR) в первой же неделе
refutations.why_fails: Связь с записью план сам оценивает как слабую (objective_fit 2). Это время мастера и место в первой неделе, которое не приводит записей. Мне нужны записи, а не просмотры.
refutations.fix: Снимать только как запасной видеоряд для других роликов, а в первой неделе выпустить вместо него ролик про услугу с окнами или ID24 для тёплой базы.

refutations.target: Мера успеха: только записи через WhatsApp
refutations.why_fails: Часть клиенток записывается звонком, приходит без записи или пишет в директ Instagram. Если клиентки перейдут со звонков на WhatsApp, график покажет «рост», а реальной загрузки не прибавится.
refutations.fix: Добавить одну цифру из журнала записей или кассы: общее число визитов в неделю против 4 недель до старта. Её я могу присылать раз в неделю одной строкой.

refutations.target: Сроки ответов и нагрузка на меня: ответ «до 10.10 12:00», 8 вопросов, утверждение каждой пачки
refutations.why_fails: Сегодня 09.10, на ответы остаётся меньше суток. В сумме вопросы занимают ровно 15 минут, а дальше ещё еженедельное утверждение 5–7 роликов с вариантами хуков. Это больше обещанных 5 минут в неделю. Метки «Видео»/«Записан» тоже работа администратора, а в 17 минутах её не посчитали.
refutations.fix: Сдвинуть срок до 12.10. Утверждение сделать одним сообщением со списком «да/нет» и превью. Время администратора на метки (≈5 мин/день) посчитать честно и согласовать со мной.

refutations.target: Экспорт переписки с клиентами
refutations.why_fails: Это персональные данные клиенток (Закон РК о персональных данных). Если что-то утечёт, позор будет мой, а не ИИ.
refutations.fix: Написать, куда и кто загружает файл, когда его удаляют. Предложить вариант: администратор сам убирает номера и имена перед отправкой.

output.persona: veteran_creator: short-form creator and SMM for local businesses in Kazakhstan/CIS (salons, cafes, service shops in Shymkent, Almaty and Tashkent), filming on budget phones with busy staff
output.best_idea: The WhatsApp layer is the best idea, not any of the videos. It sends the price together with a next-step question («Хотите, подберём мастера и время? Какой день удобнее?»), checks reply time first, and runs DR0 (fix slow replies or master churn before making content). In a Shymkent salon with a 0 ₸ budget and 4 weeks, this is the only part that can realistically stop the decline. Of the videos, ID15 «Перед тоем» is the best fit: October–November is peak той season in the south. Keep it in week 1, but rewrite it as described below.

refutations.target: Slate as a whole vs the brief ('конкуренты дешевле, клиенты уходят')
refutations.why_fails: The client's problem is 'why pay more'. None of the 8 ideas shows what the price pays for. why_it_costs / process_full is pushed to NEXT BATCH. In the CIS the proven answer to a cheaper salon next door is showing your own hygiene and materials, without comparing to anyone: the dry-heat steriliser, opening the sealed craft pouch in front of the client, a new single-use file, the brand of the gel bottle, how long a proper service takes. None of this is a comparison, so it fits the PRICE POSITION rule. It needs no price fact. It takes about 3 minutes to film at the station. Instead the slate leads with ASMR and a wildcard telling people to do it at home. A salon owner under price pressure would look at this batch and ask 'where is the reason to pay?'
refutations.fix: Move why_it_costs / process_full into week 1 as two episodes. (1) «Что происходит до того, как вы сели в кресло»: steriliser, sealed pouch opened on camera, new file, desk wiped. (2) «Почему маникюр у нас идёт 1,5 часа» or a similar line, only after a master confirms the real steps. Both go in «Глазами мастера», with no price and no 'у других'. Drop ID19 or ID01 from week 1 to make room.

refutations.target: Attribution: per-video {CODE} typed into WhatsApp
refutations.why_fails: People in Shymkent don't type codes from Reels. They tap the link, send «Здравствуйте, сколько стоит?» or write in Instagram Direct. The coded count will be close to zero, and DR5, DR7 and Thompson allocation will then make decisions on noise. Instagram Direct is also missing as a booking channel, even though it is where most beauty inquiries in KZ actually start.
refutations.fix: Make the prefilled wa.me link carry the code. Put it in the bio or link-in-bio, in the story link sticker and in the TikTok bio. The viewer only taps; she never types. Add Instagram Direct with a keyword auto-reply ('напишите МАСТЕР') and the same «Видео»/«Записан» labels. Use one code per series, not per video, so counts reach a readable size. Treat admin-asked 'откуда узнали' as the primary source.

refutations.target: Big idea «Познакомьтесь с мастером до записи» + no faces, no names by default
refutations.why_fails: You can't 'meet' a master from anonymous hands. In CIS beauty, clients follow a person: her face, her name, her personal Instagram. With the default (hands only, no voice, no name), ID17 becomes text over hands. The hero series then loses the one thing the big idea promises, and every nail macro looks like every other salon's.
refutations.fix: Make getting one master's consent to show her face and name a week-0 task, not an optional ask. Offer her something in return: tag her personal account and pin her episode. If nobody agrees, rename the hero series to something honest about what we can show, such as «Мастер считает», and stop promising 'meet the master'.

refutations.target: Warm base: 'Status + broadcast to opted-in'
refutations.why_fails: The plan itself says the fastest lever is lapsed regulars, yet the only action is posting videos to Status. Status gets seen by maybe 10–20% of contacts and does not bring lapsed clients back. What works in KZ salons is a personal message from the client's own master.
refutations.fix: From the export, list clients who haven't booked in 6+ weeks. Write a short personal reactivation line that the admin sends from the salon WhatsApp in the master's name: «Айгерим, здравствуйте! Это Динара, ваш мастер. Давно не виделись — есть окно во вторник/среду днём, записать?». Only to existing clients who have chatted with the salon before, no discount, with the owner's OK. Track replies as their own arm.

refutations.target: Shooting 7 ideas on Tue 10-20 in 16.7 staff minutes
refutations.why_fails: The numbers only add up on paper. The gel brush pull, the finished-nail payoffs, removal on a staff member's nail and the lifted-edge shot each depend on a specific moment in a real service. Someone waits for that moment, re-sets the phone, asks the client, and gets the music turned off. Realistically that is 35–50 minutes of standby. Masters with clients won't do it, and the card won't get finished (DR14 will trigger in week 2).
refutations.fix: Cap it at 4 ideas per shoot day. Split it into two 10-minute windows, morning before the first client and the dead hour after lunch, using a staff member's own nails for every staged shot. Pre-film a 'payoff bank' of finished nails at the end of each day for 2 minutes. Cut ID13 and ID09 from the first card.

refutations.target: Language: RU-only captions in Шымкент, KZ only 'after a native check'
refutations.why_fails: Шымкент is one of the most Kazakh-speaking cities in the country. Той content in Russian only feels foreign to exactly the women who organise the той. Kazakh or mixed-language hooks usually get more local reach and shares there.
refutations.fix: Ask the masters in week 0, since they are native speakers, to dictate Kazakh hook lines for ID15 and ID20. Publish both as bilingual hooks (KZ big, RU small) and A/B one той episode in KZ only.

refutations.target: ID01 «Так звучит маникюр вблизи» (close-sound ASMR)
refutations.why_fails: Nail-filing ASMR is one of the most saturated nail formats in RU/KZ, so it is no longer a 'convention break' (E25 is unverified). «Включите звук» is a dead cliché. A weak phone in a working salon picks up hairdryer and chatter. Brand link is 2 and objective fit is 2, and it opens the week as the first public post of a salon that has a price problem.
refutations.fix: Keep the footage as B-roll and don't publish it in the week-1 slot. If you post it, use the sound as the hook for a proof piece: «Звук новой пилки — её открыли при вас». The ASMR hook then carries a hygiene and value message.

refutations.target: ID15 POV той, and the «постановка» label
refutations.why_fails: The situation is strong, but there is a contradiction. The CTA asks for the той date, and the capacity rule forbids promising anything. The viewer who 'has no manicure for tomorrow' gets «подскажем время», which means nothing to her. The label is also not the problem it's flagged as: everyone knows POV is staged.
refutations.fix: Rewrite the payoff toward booking ahead: «Не будь этой девушкой — напишите дату тоя сейчас, мастер закрепит время». Keep a small «постановка» tag at the bottom and don't make it a big frame of its own.

refutations.target: ID19 anti-sell 'иногда салон вам не нужен'
refutations.why_fails: In the middle of price pressure, the default owner answer will be «2 — нет». If she says yes, it confirms to price-sensitive viewers that they can skip you. It is a reasonable wildcard for a healthy salon, but this week it is the wrong one.
refutations.fix: Swap it for a myth or honest-signal piece that defends value: «Почему мастер не будет торопиться, даже если вы спешите». Hold the anti-sell idea for a later sprint.

refutations.target: Coverage: 7/8 ideas are nails
refutations.why_fails: 8 masters probably include hair and brows/lashes, and that may be where the free slots are. Nail content will fill nail chairs, which may already be the busiest.
refutations.fix: Make sure week 1 has at least 2 non-nail episodes. Brow mapping macro with thread and pencil and hair-wash or blow-dry close sound are both hands-only and quick to film. Choose which services to cover only after the owner answers question 3.

refutations.target: Comment prompts («Какой звук в салоне вы любите?», «На что вы смотрите первым?»)
refutations.why_fails: These are generic open questions and won't get comments from local followers. Binary, pick-a-side prompts do much better in KZ beauty accounts.
refutations.fix: Switch to either/or prompts: «Квадрат или миндаль перед тоем? 1 или 2», «Сами снимаете гель — да/нет», «Нюд или красный на той?».

refutations.target: Owner asks: 8 separate asks
refutations.why_fails: The constraint is ≤15 minutes of onboarding. Eight asks is about 15 minutes on paper, but in practice the owner answers 3 and ignores the rest. Then all the defaults apply, and with faces off, voice off and anti-sell off, the slate shrinks to nail macros.
refutations.fix: Bundle everything into one voice-note-friendly message: 4 numbered yes/no answers plus 2 attachments (export, price photo). Put master consent and the export first.

output.name: Seen up close, at full price (price_pressure, Шымкент beauty salon, HYPOTHETICAL client, sprint 2026-10-19 → 2026-11-15) — revision 2
output.big_idea: A client compares prices because she cannot see what the price pays for: the hygiene before she sits down, the steps and time a careful master takes, and the master's judgment. So every week we show those things up close, at 20 cm, on real hands, with no comparison to anyone. We start with the clients who already know us and the services that have free slots. This gives at least 20 episodes: hygiene and prep steps for each service, the process of each service, what a master refuses, what she checks, care between visits and preparing for a той, across nails, hair and brows. It can be proven on camera because only real routine is filmed. It points at one action: a coded WhatsApp chat asking for a free slot, booked through the salon's own number.
output.why_this_wins:
This is a plan that lets audience data choose, not a forecast (L1, L001, L003). The message has no price, number or comparison, so it needs no ledger fact (facts_usable is empty). It is true by construction, because every episode only shows routine the owner or master has confirmed and the camera has filmed.

What changed from revision 1, and why:
(1) The fatal gap is closed. The brief is «зачем платить больше», so the hero is now the proof series «Вблизи у мастера» (I01 price_value: E04, E05, E06, E13, E16; I07 content reality: E21, E22). It leads week 1 with a hygiene episode and a process episode. The ASMR loop (ID01) and the anti-sell wildcard (ID19) no longer lead the salon's first public week.
(2) The fastest lever gets the effort. REALISM gives organic reach a ratio of 0.6–5.9, so weeks 1–2 put about 40% of effort into the warm base. That means personal reactivation messages to clients who haven't come in for 6–10 weeks (I10: E32, E05, E03), plus Status. This arm is measured on its own.
(3) The owner's master-flight risk (I08: E26) is built in. By default, masters are not named in public, every episode is salon-branded, and booking goes only through the salon number. The 'meet the master' promise is dropped, so the person series is honestly called «Мастер считает».
(4) Free capacity drives the slate. At least 2 of the 4 week-1 videos are on the service the owner names as having free slots, which is non-nail by default.
(5) Kazakh is the default for the той series. Masters dictate and check the Kazakh lines, which satisfies L9.
(6) Attribution works by tapping. Prefilled wa.me links carry the code, Instagram Direct is added, and the admin's «откуда узнали?» question is the primary source.

Other insights in use: I05 for the той moment (E19, E20), I06 for hidden knowledge (E23, E17, E25, E30), I09 for the honest-signal wildcard (from week 3, only with the owner's «да»).

Caveat: every insight is assumption-only (strength ≤2). Step 3 is rerun on the export and the 2GIS fetch by 2026-10-16, and step 4 is rerun the same day to produce the two hero episodes (NEXT BATCH).

Learning plan: video arms are read by series with relative views plus shares and saves until there are 20 attributed chats. The reactivation arm is read separately by bookings per 100 messages. The bilingual vs KZ-only test runs on the той series.

series.name: «Вблизи у мастера»
series.role: HERO. Proof and price_value: it shows what the price pays for, with no price and no «у других». Metrics: saves + shares per 1k, attributed chats per 1k, and chat→booking rate of those chats at the current price. Opening ritual (fixed): frame 1 is an extreme close-up (≤20 cm) of a prep, hygiene or process step already in motion, with its real sound. The series tag sits top-centre and the first text line names the step. Fixed structure: the step → why the master does it («мастер считает», only for routine the owner or master has confirmed) → payoff close-up → CTA for a free slot through the salon number. Variable: the service and the step. It rotates across nails, hair and brows, led by the services with free slots. Episodes: E1 hygiene «Что происходит до того, как вы сели в кресло» (steriliser, sealed pouch opened on camera, new file, desk wiped; uses ID01's file footage). series.name: «Мастер считает»

Opening ritual: a master's hands already working at her own station, her voice starting by 0.5 s (recorded at 25–30 cm in «тихий угол»), and the series tag top-centre. The salon is branded; the master is not named by default (owner risk: clients follow masters). A name appears only with the owner's separate «да» for that master, and a face only with her consent too. Booking always goes through the salon's WhatsApp, never a personal number. series.name: «Перед тоем» (KZ title dictated by a native-speaker master)

On screen by default: the KZ hook large and the RU line small, each line ≤8 words, ≤12 words visible at once. KZ text is only what a native-speaker master dictated or checked. Test: one той episode runs KZ-only vs bilingual (caption-language variant). The CTA asks for the event date and never promises a slot.
series.cadence: 1/week, timed 10–14 days before той weekends once dates are verified.

series.name: «Между визитами»
series.role: SUPPORTING. SECONDARY retention, raised to about 40% of effort in weeks 1–2 at the owner's request. Metrics: replies and bookings per 100 reactivation messages, and repeat bookings from existing contacts. Two parts. (a) The non-video reactivation arm: the admin sends a personal message from the salon WhatsApp to clients who haven't booked in 6–10 weeks, in their own master's name only with the owner's OK, with no discount, and offering only slots confirmed that day. These messages carry their own label «Возврат». (b) Care content (ID24) plus the week's best video on WhatsApp Status. Broadcasts go only to opted-in contacts.

offer.proposal: Без акций и без скидок: цену не трогаем, это решение владельца. В сообщениях постоянным клиенткам — тоже без скидки, только свободное время, подтверждённое администратором в тот же день. Кандидат на 3-ю неделю (только после «да» владельца и только если на 2-й неделе чаты останавливаются после цены): «Пришлите в WhatsApp фото ваших ногтей и код {CODE} — мастер посмотрит и до записи подскажет, что подойдёт». Бесплатно, без обязательства записаться, до 15.11, без ограничений по количеству. Тест: тот же формат роликов с этим предложением и без него.

channels.role: This is where bookings close and the most likely leak, so it is fixed in week 0. Booking happens ONLY through the salon's number; masters' personal numbers never appear. Attribution is tap-only: every video's CTA, story link sticker, bio link and TikTok bio uses a prefilled wa.me link whose message already contains the code, e.g. «Здравствуйте! Я по видео МАСТЕР-3». The viewer never types. Per-video codes stay as code assigns them, but decisions are read per series (strategist judgment, to reach readable counts). The admin asks every codeless chat «Подскажите, откуда вы о нас узнали?» and labels «Видео»; this is the primary attribution source, and codes are the floor. Labels are «Видео», «Записан» and «Возврат». Target first reply ≤15 min in working hours; if the export shows a median over 60 min, that is leak #1 and is fixed before content scales. Quick replies are drafted by the agent and approved once. (1) Coded chat: «Здравствуйте! Вы по видео {CODE}. Подскажите, какая услуга и какой день вам удобен — сразу скажем, у какого мастера есть окно.» (2) After a price, using only the dated price list: «[цена из прайса]. Хотите, подберём мастера и время? Какой день вам удобнее?» (3) Codeless: «Подскажите, пожалуйста, откуда вы о нас узнали?» (4) Handover: «Спасибо, что пришли! Если понравилось — пара слов в 2ГИС очень поможет мастеру.» No incentive for reviews. We never argue about price and never mention other salons.

Personal 1:1 messages to existing clients who have chatted with the salon before and whose last booking was 6–10 weeks ago. The admin finds them in her own WhatsApp chat list, sorted by date; the agent supplies the criteria and the text, and no client data leaves the salon. The owner approves the text once. Template: «Здравствуйте, {имя}! Это {имя мастера}, ваш мастер из салона. Давно не виделись — есть свободное время {день/время, подтверждённое сегодня}. Записать вас?» If the owner does not allow the master's name: «Это администратор салона, вы были у нас у мастера {имя мастера}…», or with no name at all. No discount, at most 1 message per client per sprint, and anyone who answers «не пишите» goes on a do-not-contact list. Replies get the «Возврат» label and are tracked as their own arm.

The week's best 2 videos go to existing contacts, plus ID24 from week 2. In weeks 1–2 the hygiene episode and the той episode go to Status. Broadcasts go only to contacts who opted in. Free-slot announcements appear only when the admin confirms them the same day.

Account status is unknown: the agent searches, and a missing account is an owner ask. Reels is the shop window where Шымкент clients check that the salon is legitimate. Instagram Direct is a booking channel. Where the account supports it, a keyword auto-reply («Напишите МАСТЕР») sends the prefilled wa.me link; otherwise the admin uses saved replies. Direct chats get the same labels «Видео»/«Записан» and the question «откуда узнали?». Bio: services, address (from 2GIS) and a prefilled wa.me link with a bio code. Story link stickers carry each video's prefilled link. Pin 3 posts: the best «Вблизи у мастера» episode, the best «Мастер считает» episode, and «Как записаться». Highlights: «Как записаться», «Гигиена» (only filmed, confirmed routine), «Отзывы» (public 2GIS screenshots, no names). No «Цены» highlight until a dated price list is in the ledger. Masters' personal accounts are not tagged unless the owner says «да» for that master.

Non-follower reach and the fastest test bed. Creating an account needs the owner's OK. The bio carries a prefilled wa.me link with a bio code. It is a cold start, so arms are not judged on its first 5–10 posts.
Cheap cross-post with a search tail. Titles use plain service words, e.g. «Снятие гель-лака у мастера» or «Стерилизация инструментов в салоне», and only for steps that were actually filmed.

Proof and local intent. The agent fetches the rating, review count and recurring praise words (guardrail baseline, future I04 content). Photos are refreshed with real hands-on work and filmed hygiene routine. The handover quick reply asks for a review. Never fake or incentivised reviews.

Only for DR2 posts with ≥1 attributed chat or a conversion role, using click-to-WhatsApp within a Шымкент radius. Ceiling CPQC_cap = average check × gross margin × close rate × 0.3, computed in week 2 from the owner's numbers and the export. Stop-loss: stop if spend reaches 5× the cap with fewer than 3 attributed chats, or if cost per attributed chat rises 3 days in a row. Never with an unconfirmed offer.

measurement.attribution:
Tap-only codes. Every video's prefilled wa.me link already contains its code, in the story link sticker, the Instagram bio or link-in-bio, the TikTok bio, and wherever links are clickable. The code is also on screen for ≥2 s, in the caption and in the pinned comment.
The PRIMARY source is the admin's «Подскажите, откуда вы о нас узнали?» asked in every chat that has no code, including Instagram Direct chats, labelled «Видео». Coded chats are a floor.
Per-video codes stay as code assigns them, but allocation and decisions read at SERIES level (code + «видео» answers pooled per series) so counts reach a readable size (strategist judgment).
Reactivation messages carry the «Возврат» label and are a separate arm, never mixed with video attribution.
Total weekly bookings vs the 4-week baseline are an estimate. Walk-ins: the admin asks «откуда узнали?» and tallies «видео» (assumption).
Attribution window: 30 days per code. No Kaspi channel.
leading_indicators: views_48h ÷ median of the last 15 posts on that platform (pooled beauty_salon median, assumed ~500, until 10 own posts), using the log ratio for arms
3-second hold / skip rate and average % watched, plus bilingual vs KZ-only on the той series
shares + saves per 1,000 views vs median, with each driver matched to its own metric (relief/proof → saves, moment_trigger → saves, identity → shares, mastery → completion)
attributed WhatsApp + Direct chats per 1,000 views (codes + «видео» answers), and the share asking for a service with free slots or giving an event date
reactivation reply rate and bookings per 100 messages (non-video arm)
measurement.review_cadence: Each post is read at 48 h (allocation) and at 7 days (final). The reactivation arm is read daily in weeks 1–2 and weekly after that. Weekly campaign read on Monday, with an owner report of ≤5 lines in Russian, true numbers only and at most 1 decision. Phase review in week 4 (2026-11-13). Code attribution window: 30 days. The allocation metric is relative views plus shares and saves until the client reaches 20 attributed chats in total; after that, attributed chats per 1,000 views, read per series.

decision_rules: DR0 (client-specific, week 0): if the export shows a median first reply over 60 min in working hours, or that most lost clients left with a departed master, fixing replies or staffing comes first. Conversion CTAs are held, and the owner is told in one sentence.
DR1 Read every post at 48 h and at 7 days, per platform, against that platform's own baseline.

DR2 Breakout: ≥3× platform median at 48 h (≈1,500 views on the pooled ~500 median [ASSUMPTION]; switch to the own median after 10 posts), or shares + saves per 1k ≥2× median. Within 7 days: a part 2 or the same insight in a new format, plus a reply to the top comment. Pin it if conversion-relevant, put it on Status, and make it boost-eligible. At ≥10× (≈5,000 views) it becomes a series, and the owner hears «вирусный» described as a tail event.
DR3 Hook failure (3-second hold <0.7× account median): re-cut with a different first frame and hook text, and repost ≥7 days later, once only.
DR4 Body failure (hold OK, completion <0.7× median): shorten and move the payoff earlier in the next episode. No repost as is.

DR5 Conversion-layer miss: views on plan but attributed chats (codes + «видео» answers) under 30% of plan by the end of week 3. Illustrative plan ≈8/week [ASSUMPTION], recomputed after the export. Before more content, check the prefilled links, story sticker, bio, Direct auto-reply and reply time.
DR6 Sales-handling miss: attributed chats on plan but chat→booking below baseline. Report where chats die and draft reply scripts. Price stays the owner's call, and we never propose a discount.

DR7 Attention-only arm (≥10 posts, ≥10,000 views, 0 attributed chats while other arms convert): cap at 1 post/week and use its footage as B-roll. A bare ASMR loop (ID01 alone) is never published unless it carries a hero proof message.
DR8 Retire an arm when P(arm beats client median) <0.10 after ≥8 posts: drop it to the exploration floor; its data stays in the pool.

DR9 Boost only DR2 posts with ≥1 attributed chat or a conversion role, within the owner's cap (average check × gross margin × close rate × 0.3, computed in week 2). Stop-loss: stop if spend reaches 5× the cap with fewer than 3 attributed chats, or if cost per chat rises 3 days in a row. Never with an unconfirmed offer.

DR10 Capacity and coverage: every week, ≥2 base videos go to services or masters with owner-confirmed free slots. When attributed demand for a master or service reaches ≥80% of her reported free slots, pause CTAs pointing there and redirect to other free slots. CTAs and reactivation messages offer only slots the admin confirmed that day.

DR11 Honesty kill-switch: if a comment credibly disputes something shown (a hygiene step, a care tip, the removal opinion), pause that series, verify with the master, and tell the owner the same day. A hygiene step is shown only if it is done for every client. Price-comparison comments get a calm reply draft and are never argued with or answered by naming anyone.

DR12 Pivot: if by week 4 no arm has P(beats median) >0.6 and weekly bookings are still below baseline, rerun step 3 with fresh chats and voice notes, diagnose the funnel, and send the owner options: another bottleneck, more warm base, a non-price offer, boost, or pause.
DR13 Claims: a «winner» needs P(best) ≥0.9, n ≥10 per contender and an interval. Otherwise it is «лидирует, рано судить». The KZ-only vs bilingual test reports direction only this sprint.

DR14 Staff: if card completion is below 80% for 2 weeks, or a window overruns by more than 5 min, go to 3 ideas per card, only «маникюрный стол», staff members' own nails, and more zero-minute reply and re-cut videos. A card never has more than 4 ideas.
DR15 Owner: if more than 30% of the batch is rejected, read the reasons and update the constraints. A fact rejection means fixing the ledger first.
DR16 Never delete flops, except for truth, consent or legal problems.

REACT1 Reactivation [thresholds are ASSUMPTIONS, re-set after the export]: send in waves of ≤20 per day. After the first 40 messages, if ≥4 bookings (≥10%), extend to clients lapsed 10–16 weeks in week 2. If <2 bookings, stop, and in week 3 read the replies for the real reason clients left (price / master / other) as evidence. If ≥2 «не пишите» or complaints, stop and tell the owner the same day. Each client gets at most 1 message per sprint, and the do-not-contact list is permanent.

MASTER1 Master-flight guard: a master's name, face or personal account appears in public content only with the owner's separate «да» for that master (and her consent for face and voice). Booking always goes through the salon number. If a featured master leaves, her episodes are unpinned (not deleted, DR16) and her CTA is redirected to the salon.
learning_questions: Is reactivating clients lapsed 6–10 weeks with a personal no-discount message a faster source of full-price bookings than video in weeks 1–2, and what do their replies say about why they left (price, master, or something else)?
Does the hero «Вблизи у мастера» (hygiene and process shown up close, no comparison) produce attributed chats that book at the current price, or only saves?
Do videos aimed at the services with free slots fill those slots, or does demand still pile onto nails?
Does a KZ-large/RU-small or KZ-only той episode get more shares and dated chats in Шымкент than the bilingual version?
Where do chats die (after price / «подумаю» / slow reply), and does sending the price with one next-step question raise chat→booking at unchanged prices?

owner_asks.ask: Здравствуйте, это ИИ-ассистент вашего салона. Три коротких вопроса: 1) Кто уходит — новые после цены / постоянные / вслед за мастером / не знаю? 2) Кого снимать — только руки и голос / мастеров с лицом (с их согласия) / и клиентов (с их согласия)? 3) Где больше всего свободных окон — маникюр / волосы / брови и ресницы / почти везде (если можно — у каких мастеров и в какие дни)?
